# Williams et al. (1992) Campbell water-retention regressions and parameter table.

## Source

Williams, J., Ross, P. J., & Bristow, K. L. (1992). Prediction of the Campbell water retention function from texture, structure, and organic matter. In M. Th. van Genuchten, F. J. Leij, & L. J. Lund (Eds.), Proceedings of the International Workshop on Indirect Methods for Estimating the Hydraulic Properties of Unsaturated Soils (pp. 427-441). University of California, Riverside.

## Scope

**Territory:** Australia, England and Wales, and the United States

**Dataset:** Regressions were developed from the Prebble and Forrest Australian data sets, their combination, or the Hall England-and-Wales data set, and were evaluated where compatible against independent Australian, UK, and US data.

## Functions

### `calc_ptf_williams1992_function_1`

Predict volumetric water content with Williams et al. Function 1.

**Status:** `implemented`

**Prediction target:** Volumetric water content at a specified water-potential magnitude.

**Models:** $h(\theta)$ — Campbell power-function retention model

#### Inputs

| Name | Type | Unit | Domain | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `clay` | `number` | % | 0 < value <= 100 | Clay below 0.002 mm, as a mass percentage. |
| `fine_sand` | `number` | % | 0 <= value <= 100 | Fine sand from 0.02 to 0.20 mm, as a mass percentage. |
| `coarse_sand` | `number` | % | 0 < value <= 100 | Coarse sand from 0.20 to 2.0 mm, as a mass percentage. |
| `organic_matter` | `number` | % | value > 0 | Organic-matter mass percentage. |
| `water_potential` | `number` | bar | value > 0 | Water-potential magnitude. |

#### Outputs

| Name | Unit | Domain | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `water_content` | % | value > 0 | Predicted volumetric water content at the supplied water-potential magnitude. |

!!! note

    Natural logarithms are used.

!!! warning

    The source does not publish exact multivariate calibration boundaries.

### `calc_ptf_williams1992_table5`

Return the published Function 7 Campbell parameters for a Table 5 soil group.

**Status:** `implemented`

**Prediction target:** Campbell exponent and nominal air-entry head at 1.4 g/cm^3 bulk density.

**Models:** $h(\theta)$ — Campbell power-function retention model

#### Inputs

| Name | Type | Unit | Domain | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `soil_group` | `Table5SoilGroup` | — | — | Published structure and field-texture combination used to select a Table 5 row. |

#### Outputs

| Name | Unit | Domain | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `b` | dimensionless | value > 0 | Campbell moisture-characteristic exponent predicted with Function 7. |
| `air_entry_head` | cm | value > 0 | Campbell nominal air-entry pressure-head magnitude predicted with Function 7. |

!!! note

    All rows use the source-fixed bulk density of 1.4 g/cm^3.

!!! warning

    The tabulated values are rounded predictions from Function 7.
